proposed.text: Which professional may sign and seal architectural drawings, specifications, and other architectural documents under RA 9266?

options.text: A registered and licensed architect acting within the architectural scope
Any registered professional on the project, regardless of discipline

rationale.a: Assigns architectural authority to a non-structural matter; architects do not have authority to sign structural drawings.
rationale.b: Overgeneralizes; only structural or civil engineers specifically licensed for structural design can sign; other engineering disciplines cannot.
rationale.d: Assigns professional sealing authority to a non-licensed project manager; sealing requires a licensed engineer, not a management role.
rationale.correct: Under RA 544 (Civil Engineering Law), only a Registered Civil Engineer may sign and seal structural and foundation drawings. The structural professional's signature certifies the structural adequacy of the design and compliance with structural and building codes.
rationale.takeaway: Only a Registered Licensed Structural or Civil Engineer may sign and seal structural and foundation drawings.
